caseStudies.title: Component Split Architecture
caseStudies.problem: The issue asked for a literal 4-folder split (logo/menu/sidebar/footer) based on a screenshot mockup.
caseStudies.aiAction: Read the actual code first, found one IIFE sharing state across all 4 sections, surfaced the mismatch as a question instead of deciding silently, then reshaped the plan into a 5-folder (+shared/), 6-ticket breakdown after human confirmation.
caseStudies.outcome: Closed end-to-end across 6 sub-tickets, no rework cycles. Instruction Fidelity 5 / Result Satisfaction 5.

caseStudies.title: Dark-theme Token Fix
caseStudies.problem: Test Report Dashboard text was unreadable in dark theme — shared color tokens (--chloe-mint/--chloe-pink/--chloe-cream) used as solid backgrounds had no dark-theme-aware text pairing.
caseStudies.aiAction: Confirmed the root cause, shipped AC1-AC4 through a Test PR to Code PR loop, then at close captured the fix as a new reusable skill (theme-token-background-audit).
caseStudies.outcome: Shipped and released to production, plus a new published skill so the same bug class gets caught earlier next time. Instruction Fidelity 5 / Result Satisfaction 5.

caseStudies.title: Now Playing & Recently Played (Data Fetch & Metadata Rendering)
caseStudies.problem: Now Playing card needed live stream metadata + cover art, but the 10s poll caused a visible cover-art flicker on every refresh tick.
caseStudies.aiAction: Root-caused the flicker (unconditional cache-bust on every poll), then proposed a labeled menu of fix options (SHA-256 hash compare vs. ETag) with tradeoffs, implementing only after the human's pick.
caseStudies.outcome: Fixed and merged — though a new function shipped without proactively offering a unit test, an honest gap the human flagged afterward. Instruction Fidelity 4 / Result Satisfaction 5.
